Allowed origins (CORS in `worker/src/index.ts`, Hono `cors()` middleware with an `origin` function — see docs §4 in `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md`):

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any origin ending in `.pages.dev`
- any origin ending in `.workers.dev`
- anything else → `null` (rejected)

To add a custom domain, edit the `origin` function inside `app.use('*', cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} }))` in `worker/src/index.ts`, adding a check like `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'` (or an `.endsWith(...)` check for a subdomain pattern) to the `if` condition before it returns `origin`. Note: Hono's string-array origin matching only does exact literal matches, so wildcards must go through this function form, not a plain array.
